Round 3: point cloud variants

Variations of 05 from round 1: deep as a point cloud that becomes a solid splat. Points cannot be resolved at 20 px, so every variant switches to a solid version in the header bar row. Every wordmark is lowercase Space Grotesk, outlined to vector paths, so any of these can be exported straight to design/brand/logos/. Each concept shows paper and viewport backgrounds, an app icon at 64, 32 and 16 px, and the lockup at 20 px inside a header bar.
